context.transcript:
As you all know, our software company started a fundraiser to launch a summer camp for kids who want to become computer programmers.
We've already raised a nice amount of money.
In fact, we've run out of thank-you gifts for the $10 donation level.
So now, anyone who makes a donation of $10 will receive a baseball hat instead.
Also, please remember to check your email for a link to the fundraiser survey.
Completing this survey will help us to make informed decisions about what kinds of youth programs to run in the future.
context.transcript_translation:
如你们所知，我们的软件公司发起了一项募捐活动，为那些想成为计算机程序员的孩子们启动一个夏令营。
我们已经筹集了可观的资金。
事实上，我们已经用完了 10 美元捐赠级别感谢礼品的库存。
所以现在，任何捐款 10 美元的人都会收到一顶棒球帽作为礼物。
另外，请记得查看您的电子邮件，获取募捐调查问卷的链接。
完成这份调查将帮助我们对未来应该开展哪些类型的青少年项目做出明智的决定。
